newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVENERGO AUDITED '96 RESULTS BY JULY 31.
newsitem.headline: LATVENERGO AUDITED '96 RESULTS BY JULY 31.

text.p: The Latvian Privatisation Agency (LPA) said on Wednesday that the audited 1996 results for energy company Latvenergo, the state-run electricity firm currently being prepared for sell-off, will be available by July 31.

"Deloite & Touche auditing firm has submitted its report on Latvenergo's (results), still to be approved by its board and council, which we hope to provide to investors by July 31," Janis Naglis, LPA manager, told a news conference.
A seminar on the Latvenergo sell-off, under the auspices of the World Bank and the European Bank for Resconstructiona dn Development will be held on July 31.
"An agreement has alreay been reached with a number of applicants interested in privatising Latvenergo (about their participation)," Naglis said.
The Latvenergo sell-off plan calls for it to be transformed into a holding company by January 1998 comprised of four competing generating companies and the grid forming a separate firm.
